meta_title: Hutchison Grounds Care | Landscape Gardeners Birmingham
meta_description: Hutchison Grounds Care is a professional landscape gardener in Birmingham B36. Garden design, maintenance, and tree work. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Expert landscape gardening that turns overgrown spaces into beautiful outdoor rooms you'll actually use.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From initial design through to ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of garden transformation.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts tailored to your space, style, and budget. We take your ideas and turn them into a practical, beautiful design before any digging starts.

services.title: Lawn Laying & Turf Installation
services.desc: High-quality turf installation with proper soil preparation. A new lawn transforms a garden in weeks, not years — and ours is laid to last.

services.title: Planting & Border Design
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and borders that deliver year-round colour and structure. We choose plants suited to your soil and sunlight, not just what looks good in the catalogue.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professionally laid patios, decking, and pathways using quality materials. We create hard-standing that handles Birmingham weather and frames your garden properly.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Professional pruning, shaping, and removal of trees and shrubs. Keeps your garden safe, healthy, and looking its best.

services.title: Ongoing Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep — grass cutting, weeding, hedge trimming, and seasonal care. One call to manage it all, so your garden stays looking fresh without the weekend work.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted gardens done right — not rushed, not expensive.
about_para_1: Hutchison Grounds Care was founded with a simple aim: deliver landscape gardening that lasts. Over 15 years, we've transformed hundreds of gardens across Birmingham and the surrounding areas — from overgrown backyards to show-stopping outdoor spaces. We believe in understanding what you want, designing it properly, and then building it to last.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen first, plan thoroughly, and take genuine care in the work. We're not here to upsell or rush through jobs. Every garden is different, and we treat each one as if it's our own. That's why word-of-mouth keeps our diary full year after year.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our back garden was a total mess — just overgrown weeds and broken fencing. Dave came round, listened to what we wanted, and came back with a proper plan. The transformation is incredible. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Hutchison out to do regular maintenance through the summer. They're reliable, turn up on time, and take proper care of the garden. No faffing about, just good honest work at a fair price.
reviews.author: Linda W.

reviews.text: Brilliant team. Laid a new patio and planted some borders in spring. Garden looks completely different now. They explained everything as they went and cleaned up properly when they finished. Will definitely call them back.
reviews.author: James H.
